guide.title: How to build the shortcut
guide.endpoint: Endpoint (URL of the "Get contents of" action)
guide.body: JSON body - replace the placeholders with the trigger variables
guide.step_trigger: Shortcuts app > Automation > New > Transaction. Pick your card, and turn "Run immediately" off so it asks first.
guide.step_request: Add "Get contents of" with the URL above, method POST.
guide.step_auth: Add a header: Authorization = Bearer <your token>.
guide.step_body: Request body: JSON, with the fields above. Insert the Amount and Merchant variables the trigger provides; send the transaction Date when the trigger exposes it.
guide.step_notification: Add "Show notification" with the "message" value from the response, so you can see what was added.
guide.step_test: Test it once with "dryRun": "true" in the body: nothing is created, and the response tells you what would be.
guide.fallback: If your bank does not fill the Amount or Merchant variables, use the same shortcut without the automation trigger: add "Ask for input" for the amount and the merchant, and run it from the home screen or the share sheet.
